name: Nexthop AI
description: Nexthop AI is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Nexthop AI is a privately held data center networking company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $500 million Series B round announced on March 10, 2026, valued the company at $4.2 billion.

Founded in 2024 and based in Santa Clara, California, Nexthop AI builds network switches and related software for the data centers of large cloud and AI operators. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company. Nexthop AI announced its March 2025 financing when it emerged from stealth and did not give it a round name.
round_notes: Lightspeed Venture Partners led the Series B, which Nexthop AI described as oversubscribed.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Lightspeed Venture Partners led the Series B, in which Andreessen Horowitz joined as a major investor and Altimeter also participated. Lightspeed Venture Partners also led the March 2025 financing. Other investors include Kleiner Perkins, Battery Ventures, WestBridge Capital and Emergent Ventures.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Nexthop AI appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Nexthop AI's Series B announcement (March 10, 2026); Gunderson Dettmer's notice of the March 2025 financing; reporting by Bloomberg (March 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
